content.value: Obtain the linear transformation which reduces the quadratic form $1 2 \mathbf { x } _ { 1 } ^ { 2 } + 4 \mathbf { x } _ { 2 } ^ { 2 } + 5 \mathbf { x } _ { 3 } ^ { 2 } - 6 \mathbf { x } _ { 1 } \mathbf { x } _ { 2 } - 4 \mathbf { x } _ { 2 } \mathbf { x } _ { 3 } + 6 \mathbf { x } _ { 1 } \mathbf { x } _ { 3 }$ to the sum of squares and hence reduce it to the canonical form.
